prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a two-storey house in a stone-and-plaster harbour town on a windy northern coast. terracotta clay tile roof in warm red-orange cream plaster walls with dark timber framing and a stone plinth. Windows have small panes glowing warm amber from inside (the only light). The whole image is 176 x 224 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.
revised_prompt: Edit the supplied layout guide into ONE isolated two-storey harbour-town house game sprite. Use the supplied image as a STRICT geometric template, not merely inspiration: 1232x1568 canvas representing 176x224 square art pixels at 7x nearest-neighbor scale. Retain the exact straight-edged rectangular building silhouette: roof x=14..1218, y=196..938, including its horizontal roof segmentation at y=523-537; front facade x=56..1176, y=939..1567. Roof is viewed FROM ABOVE as a broad rectangular surface, front facade is viewed STRAIGHT ON, not an isometric triangular gable. Keep four windows exactly where the guide shows them: upper left x=336..448 y=1036..1176, upper right x=770..882 y=1036..1176, lower left x=336..448 y=1344..1484, lower right x=770..882 y=1344..1484. Each gets small dark timber mullions dividing warm amber-lit panes; no additional windows. Preserve any door indicated in the guide in its precise original size and location as a dark brown usable door at ground level, never move or omit it; if door isn't visible in the supplied template, add one discreet ground-level walkable dark brown door without interfering with the four windows. Art direction: premium hand-placed hi-bit JRPG top-down pixel art, weathered northern coastal stone and cream plaster two-storey wall with visible dark timber framing, stone plinth, broad warm red-orange terracotta clay tiled roof; exceptionally clean deliberate 3–10 pixel tile and masonry clusters, worn and lived in, earthy vivid colors, hue shifted saturated reddish-purple shadows and yellowish highlights, 4–6 crisp discrete colors per material. Small chimney allowed above roof into empty top margin, narrow eave trim and timber lintels, subtle small details. Neutral evenly lit clean base sprite, warm amber windows are only light, no cast shadows, no light pools, no vignette. Background MUST be fully transparent alpha, replace ALL magenta with transparency; no ground, text, humans. Sharp perfectly square evenly sized pixel edges, absolutely no anti-aliasing, blur, feathering, photographic textures, grain, or dithering. Do not distort or change proportions of template.
